contact.evidence_quote: H.I.I.T. - “High Intensity Interval Training,” while the name is a new trend, the workout theory has been the foundation of effective workouts for decades- and this class is sure to build a sweat. While the entire class will stimulate cardio from head to toe, the high intensity anaerobic activity will tighten and tone all that’s in between! Popular Body By Design personal trainer James Dadi will guide you through an ever changing workout!
